conversion.geometry: Source feature and part order retained. Each single-part PolyLine becomes a LineString and each multipart PolyLine a MultiLineString. Every selected source coordinate is retained without rounding, simplification, smoothing, reprojection, merging, or interpolation.

limitations: Modern generalized physical geography, not a reconstruction of any historical coastline or river channel.
Small streams, tributaries, minor islands, and local channel detail are incomplete; even 1:10m rivers can be absent in a narrow city-scale view.
Lake Centerline features represent continuity through lakes, not lake shores; lakes are not rendered as polygons.
Only genuine source coast and river/lake-centerline lines are included. No administrative borders, relief, invented ridges, or connecting segments are added.
Coordinates use WGS84 longitude/latitude. Route views crossing the antimeridian require separate regional views under the map engine contract; polar rendering follows its supported latitude limits.

resolution_selection.reason: The evaluated 50m river dataset omits the Wei (渭河) near Xi’an. The complete 10m rivers/lake-centerline dataset is used worldwide, without mixing or deduplicating river geometry across scales.
